prashna_chapter3_verse2.title: Prashna Chapter 3 Verse 2
prashna_chapter3_verse2.introduction: This verse belongs to Prashna, Chapter 3.
prashna_chapter3_verse2.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Prashna Upanishad, Chapter 3, Verse 2, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
prashna_chapter3_verse2.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
